author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description:
At the Cinema Relics collection archive, Adam is delighted to find three original props from the lesser-known science fiction film Brainstorm! Adam and Dan Lanigan discuss why they love this 1983 sci-fi thriller and the unique filming process used by director Douglas Trumball. 

Learn more about Cinema Relics prop investigations at: https://www.youtube.com/@cinemarelics/videos
Adam Savage Meets Indiana Jones' Original Golden Idol: https://youtu.be/8nBzTC1Cq7g
Inside the Stop-Motion Technology of Laika's Coraline: https://youtu.be/k1kSZSdZmeQ
The Differences Between All of Thor's Hammers in the MCU: https://youtu.be/G63fwoE2Ga4
The Original ZF-1 Prop From The Fifth Element: https://youtu.be/2qvYAK5cpF0

Shot by Joey Fameli and edited by Norman Chan
Music by Jinglepunks
